pkgTitle: Warm starts for external and coupled units
title: Q1: register a warm-start variant of the reactor?
body: Measured on 8 inlets: cold runs match today's reactor bit for bit, but warm calls were about 21 % slower overall (later stages and certificates ran longer) and differed from cold by up to 1.9e-7 relative.

options.label: No, do not register it
options.detail: Keep the gains that work (restarting a coupled run from a previous solution).
